description: Add or update the price ONE product sells at in another currency — for example EUR for an eBay site — keeping its other currencies and its own workspace-currency price. Send only an amount the user stated: never a converted or estimated price. The product's own currency is refused; change that with update_product's price. Saves through the same product-card operation as the CRM form, with a version check (on CONFLICT re-read the product and retry), and the new price reaches connected channels like a manual edit. Idempotent. The result echoes the workspace.

id.description: The product id returned by search_products or get_product.

prices.description: Channel prices to add or update, one row per currency (uppercase 3-letter ISO code, e.g. EUR), an amount greater than 0. Refused for the product's own workspace currency — use update_product's price field for that one. Never a converted or guessed value: send exactly the amount the user gave for that market.

name: upsert_product_prices
title: Set product prices in other currencies
